text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: An application for a mock race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's your birthday today, right? Here 
is a little present from us♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the gesture, but... why a 
mock race? I'd like to think we compete 
with each other plenty already.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain! Heheh, we pooled our 
pocket money and rented out a private 
racecourse for the entire day!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Zero spectators. Dia as our sole witness— 
Conditions like these don't come around 
very often.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...You're telling me to lighten my load 
and run?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! While receiving looks full 
of anticipation is quite pleasant, I 
thought switching things up like this 
wouldn't be so bad once in a while."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both Kura-chan and I decided not to tell 
anyone about this match! It's a secret 
just between the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, this special arrangement is 
strictly for this one time. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hǎo! That's the spirit! I understand 
completely. For us—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There are things you'd prioritize over 
freedom. Isn't that right?
